issues.detail: The Hebrew lists pairs: Carchemish with Calno, Arpad with Hamath, Damascus with Samaria. The Vietnamese reverses the order within each pair: 'Ca-nô không như Cạt-kê-mít' (Calno not like Carchemish) instead of 'Carchemish not like Calno', 'Ha-mát không như Aït-bát' (Hamath not like Arpad) instead of 'Arpad not like Hamath', 'Sa-ma-ri không như Đa-mách' (Samaria not like Damascus) instead of 'Damascus not like Samaria'. This swaps the subjects and objects of comparison, changing the meaning.
